answer: Decaying identity bonds stop bulk forgery. An agent locks a bond worth twice its 30-day earnings before claiming rewards; the bond loses 5% each epoch unless it keeps serving honest requests, so idle fakes bleed value. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds, 20,000 credits locked, while one honest agent pays a single bond and earns undiluted rewards. The pool stays like a lagoon kept crystal clear, where no zephyr of cheap copies drifts in free.
